obernants.operator: A passing outcome excludes observed disagreements on enumerated fixtures and oracle comparisons; untested behaviors remain admitted. This relation describes exclusions within the finite observation universe.
obernants.domain: Finite deterministic test fixtures and implementation observations.
obernants.assumptions: Lawful Eq where relevant; representable arithmetic and successful allocation where required.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived relation with bounded evidence, not universal verification.
